description: Single or multi-thumb range input. Radix renders each SliderThumb as a <span role="slider"> with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, and aria-orientation. The thumbLabel prop (a string, or a function of the thumb index) sets each thumb's aria-label; without it, two-thumb ranges fall back to Radix's English "Minimum" / "Maximum". The valueText prop (value, index) => string sets aria-valuetext (e.g. "45%").

keyboard.action: Moves focus to / from each thumb (each thumb is its own tab stop).
Decreases the focused thumb's value by step.
Increases the focused thumb's value by step.
Decreases by a larger increment (typically 10 * step).
Sets the focused thumb to its minimum.
Sets the focused thumb to its maximum.

focus.notes: Each size-5 (20px) thumb shows ring-3 ring-ring/50 on focus-visible (and on hover / active), and an invisible ::after extends it to a 44px hit area; the root is at least 44px tall (min-h-11). In multi-thumb mode, thumbs can't cross each other (Radix enforces a minStepsBetweenThumbs gap, default 0).

announcements: Each thumb announces as a slider with its current, min, and max values.
Each thumb announces its thumbLabel (or Radix's "Minimum" / "Maximum" on two-thumb ranges) so users can tell which thumb they're adjusting, and its valueText when provided.
screenReader.notes: The track and range are decorative; all ARIA lives on the thumbs. Name the thumbs with thumbLabel; an aria-label on the root does not reach the role="slider" elements.

contrast.text: N/A; no text unless the consumer renders labels / tooltips
contrast.ui: Thumb is bg-card with a 2px border-primary; track uses bg-muted with a bg-primary range. Flat orange is about 2.3:1 on the light surfaces, so the thumb position and a visible value carry the state

motion.reducedMotion: Thumb transitions colour and box-shadow (the ring) only; no motion-based animation

consumerResponsibilities: Pass thumbLabel describing what each thumb represents (e.g. "Volume", or "Minimum price" / "Maximum price"), in the page language.
Pass valueText when the raw number needs a unit or format to make sense when spoken (e.g. "45%", "1,200 USDC").
For discrete sliders, pair with a visible value label or tooltip so users don't have to rely on aria-valuenow announcements.
Set step appropriately; very small steps with arrow-key navigation become tedious, so consider pairing with PageUp / PageDown for bigger jumps.
